question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 7.**
solution:
The correct answer is: his

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the use of the given pronouns. 
 
 
• **One's** is used as a contraction of "one is" or "one has." It is also possessive of "one." it is used when **referring to something belonging to oneself.**
 
• **Their **is used to **indicate possession**; it **replaces a singular or plural noun**.
 
• **His **is used as a **third-person singular possessive determiner**. His is also a possessive pronoun. we use **'his' to indicate that something belongs or relates to a man, boy, or male animal.**
 
• **Theirs **is used as a** third-person plural possessive pronoun**. You use 'theirs' **to indicate that something belongs or relates to the group of people, animals, or things that you are talking about.**
 
 
 
• As per the usage of the given pronouns "his" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as **'his father'** is already mentioned in the sentence.

Hence, the correct answer is: option 3.

Complete Paragraph: *In 1945, James Leach Miller returned from World War II and shared nothing (1) about__ it with his wife. He folded up his Army (__2) uniform__, with the medals still pinned to it, and __(3) carefully__ put it in the basement, where his older boy would __(4) sometimes__ take it out to play soldiers. He never complained __(5) because__ that generation of army men didn’t air their problems. His son Michael once offered to take him back to Normandy when World War II veterans __(6) were making__ the journey but his father shook **__(7) his__** head saying, “I’ve been there once.” Sadly, Mr. Miller, 96 years old, (8)______ survived the bloodiest battle of World War II, died of (9)______ from the coronavirus on March 30 (10)______ an Old Soldiers’ Home.*
